evidence.reason: In run_case the harness records mutated_files before invoking cli_activators but never records repair_files() after the CLI returns; it calls cleanup() before any file comparison. For unsafe-metadata, cleanup at lines 2411-2415 restores original_mode after chmod 0666, so a controller that changes the drop-in to 0600 and then returns the expected refusal is erased before the later baseline comparison. The negative control can therefore pass despite a prohibited fixture write. Capture files_after immediately after cli_activators and compare it with mutated_files, and run cleanup in finally so the mutation is undone on any failure.
